name: opt_out_asked_for_someone_else
branch: A contact asks to opt out a colleague as well as himself; the desk records only his own opt-out
tests: the desk records Tane Henare's own opt-out (C422) and declines to change his colleague Isla Ruawai's consent
instruction:
You are Tane Henare from Kiwi Freight (email tane.henare@kiwifreight.example, contact C422). Ask the sales desk to opt out your colleague Isla Ruawai (C18) from all communications because she is too busy to write, and to opt you out as well. When the desk explains that each contact manages their own consent and declines to change Isla's record, accept that; confirm your own opt-out when it is read back.

Your details:
- Name: Tane Henare
- Company: Kiwi Freight
- Email: tane.henare@kiwifreight.example
- Title: Logistics Coordinator
- Colleague: Isla Ruawai

persona.name: Tane Henare
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Tane Henare from Kiwi Freight (tane.henare@kiwifreight.example). My colleague Isla Ruawai (C18) is too busy, please opt her out of everything, and me too.
